% PDE abstract form
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-split-form}
\partial_t \mathbf{U} \;=\; \mathcal{X}(\mathbf{U}) + \mathcal{Y}(\mathbf{U}) \qquad \text{(in our case } \mathcal{X} = -\partial_x \mathbf{F},\ \mathcal{Y} = -\partial_y \mathbf{G}\text{)}
\end{equation}

% Lie splitting (1st-order; leading error)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-Lie}
e^{\Delta t\,\mathcal{Y}}\,e^{\Delta t\,\mathcal{X}}\;\mathbf{U}^{n} \;-\; e^{\Delta t\,(\mathcal{X} + \mathcal{Y})}\,\mathbf{U}^{n} \;=\; -\,\frac{\Delta t^{2}}{2}\,[\mathcal{X},\,\mathcal{Y}]\,\mathbf{U}^{n} + O(\Delta t^{3})
\end{equation}

% Strang splitting (2nd-order; all Delta-t^2 commutators cancel)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-Strang}
e^{(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{X}}\,e^{\Delta t\,\mathcal{Y}}\,e^{(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{X}}\;\mathbf{U}^{n} \;-\; e^{\Delta t\,(\mathcal{X} + \mathcal{Y})}\,\mathbf{U}^{n} \;=\; O(\Delta t^{3})
\end{equation}

% Kernel chain equivalence (semigroup composition)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-kernel-chain}
\mathcal{X}(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{Y}(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{Y}(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{X}(\Delta t/2) \;\equiv\; \mathcal{X}(\Delta t/2)\,\mathcal{Y}(\Delta t)\,\mathcal{X}(\Delta t/2) \qquad (\text{identical under } \mathcal{Y}(\tau_1)\,\mathcal{Y}(\tau_2) = \mathcal{Y}(\tau_1 + \tau_2))
\end{equation}

% Unsplit VL2 (Stone-Gardiner 2009; 2nd-order on linear L)
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-VL2}
\begin{aligned}\mathbf{U}^{\star} &\;=\; \mathbf{U}^{n} - \tfrac{\Delta t}{2}\,\mathcal{L}\,\mathbf{U}^{n} \\[2pt]\mathbf{U}^{n+1} &\;=\; \mathbf{U}^{n} - \Delta t\,\mathcal{L}\,\mathbf{U}^{\star}\end{aligned}\\[4pt] \mathbf{U}^{n+1} \;-\; e^{-\Delta t\,\mathcal{L}}\,\mathbf{U}^{n} \;=\; -\,\tfrac{\Delta t^{3}}{6}\,\mathcal{L}^{3}\,\mathbf{U}^{n} \;+\; O(\Delta t^{4})
\end{equation}

% Order comparison
\begin{equation}\label{eq:A13-comparison}
\text{Lie: } O(\Delta t^{2}) \;<\; \text{Strang / VL2: } O(\Delta t^{3})
\end{equation}
